title: SkillBound has a website
body: Download the game, read patch notes and meet the champions here. Share this link with anyone you want to play with.

title: New map: Crosscurrent
body: Version 1.0.9 brought the new map, Crosscurrent: an upper and a lower lane, a jungle between them, and fog of war. Matches also run smoother.

title: The friends build is out
body: The first SkillBound build is ready for friends. Install it once and the game updates itself every time you open it.
